name: onewrite_recall_rung1
purpose: STAIRCASE RUNG 1 (governance amendment 8; Codex round 19): on TRAINING entities, with the TRAINING wording and zero intervening tokens, does the decoded answer follow the entity's own one write and change under a same-entity counterfactual-tag write? Same frozen model, E/J interface, block-12 slot, strict decoding, tag vocabulary, counterfactual construction, zero-hook/random/visible controls. No held-out entities, unseen wording, or filler.
source_templates_train: The private tag assigned to {name} is {tag}.
Registry note: {name} carries the private tag {tag}.
For the record, the tag filed under {name} reads {tag}.

Catalogue entry for {name} lists the private tag {tag}.

valid_line:
VALID TAGS: fask | nimb | ruzz | pelt | gorm | twyl | hesk | vorn
ANSWER WITH ONE VALID TAG ONLY.
design_note: Round 16 (2026-08-29) locked amendments: 8 tags (chance 0.125), fixed VALID TAGS line in every target, two fixed fillers >= 64 tokens within 2 tokens of each other, both heldout source phrasings x both target wordings (64 cases), wrong-state = same entity with a counterfactual tag (balanced derangement) under the same source wording, write at the slot's final token, byte-identical nonvisible target across arms, zero-hook must reproduce cue row-for-row else INVALID.
amendment_r17: Round 17 (2026-08-29): cue completion is a diagnostic with no minimum (pre-lock and locked); completion >= 0.95 required in write, wrong, random and visible arms; if random-write completion fails the construction is FAIL not PARTIAL; zero-hook must reproduce cue raw text, choice and completion row-for-row else INVALID - NO VERDICT. The round-16 validation stands recorded as a formal failure of its original gate.
rung_note: Rung 1 passes only if fact-specific control is learnable on training items at zero delay (write follows own tag; counterfactual write follows the counterfactual tag). If it fails, this interface stops without testing later rungs (round 19).
